data.name: PROTOCOL: VOID
data.detailed_description:
About:


About the Game

About This Game

Enter the VOID - a hostile digital frontier where your body is your build.

PROTOCOL: VOID is a fast-paced pixel art ARPG focused on deep character customization, loot, contracts, and online co-op. Choose your class, develop unique skill and passive trees, collect cybernetic implants, and build around powerful weapons.

Your build doesn't have to revolve around skills. Create weapon-focused setups with homing projectiles, explosive critical hits, piercing shots, and more. Relic Implants can transform both skills and weapons, opening new build possibilities and interactions.

Take on story missions, repeatable contracts, and increasingly dangerous Data Disk missions while searching for stronger equipment and upgrades.

Play alone or with up to four players in online co-op. Mix different classes and builds or bring four completely different versions of the same class.

PROTOCOL: VOID is developed by a single developer. Because of its large number of skills, items, modifiers, and possible interactions, some builds may occasionally be stronger, weaker, or less balanced than intended. The game will continue to evolve based on testing and community feedback.

Your weapon. Your skills. Your implants. Your body is your build.


Key Features:

  • 4 Playable Classes - Rifler, Hacker, Tank and Mage, each with unique mechanics, skills and passive trees.

  • Deep Build Customization - Combine weapons, skills, implants, passives and equipment to create your own playstyle.

  • Relic Implants - Over 300 relics which change how your skills and weapons work with powerful gameplay modifiers.

  • Loot & Crafting - Find, upgrade, recycle and craft equipment with randomized stats and modifiers.

  • Online Player Market - List items for sale, buy equipment from other players and trade gear through a shared online economy.

  • 4 Player Online Co-op - Play solo or complete contracts with up to four players.

  • Contracts & Data Disks - Take on story missions, repeatable contracts and increasingly dangerous endgame challenges. A lot of crafting options for late game mapping - Data disks.

  • No Pay-to-Win - Character power comes from playing the game, not your wallet.

data.short_description: PROTOCOL: VOID CONTRACT is a cyberpunk top-down action RPG for 1–4 players. Take on dangerous contracts, fight hostile systems, collect randomized weapons and cyberware, shape powerful builds, and upgrade your gear to survive deadlier missions.
